headline: Bring Acomax devices into Home Assistant
intro: Acomax devices are supported through the Motion Blinds integration. The brand's devices are rebranded products or share a communication protocol with Motion Blinds, so you can add Acomax in Home Assistant and follow the supporting integration's documentation for use.
highlights: Add Acomax from Settings > Devices & services and follow the on-screen setup
Use the Motion Blinds integration for Acomax device support and usage guidance
Acomax devices are rebranded devices or share a communication protocol with Motion Blinds

flow.title: Set up Acomax support
stages: Open Settings > Devices & services in Home Assistant
Select Acomax and follow the on-screen instructions
Refer to Motion Blinds documentation for usage information
